title: Docs: bring the Survey notebook on main up to date (docs/plans/survey*, from the research branch, those paths only)
description:
## Goal

Main carries the Survey's current notebook as reference docs, so the paper that reports on it (filed next) can cite it at main.

## Context

LIN-4248 copied the notebook onto main on the morning of 5 November. The work continued all day on branch `claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j`, and the copy on main is now a day stale. The paper that writes up the loop cites these files.

## This step

Copy these paths from `origin/claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j` at `24ac197f4` onto main, **unchanged:**

* `docs/plans/survey.md`;
* everything under `docs/plans/survey/`.

Take only those paths. **That branch also carries unrelated, unmerged code that must not land** (for example `2bebcc03`). Use `git checkout 24ac197f4 -- <paths>` or the equivalent; do not merge or cherry-pick the branch.

**Not this ticket:** editing the notebook's content; anything outside those paths.

## Done when

* `git diff 24ac197f4 HEAD -- docs/plans/survey.md docs/plans/survey/` is empty on main after the merge.
* No other path changed.

## Implemented (stub; the pre-work Survey narrative was pruned at close-out)

Implemented as approved against the revised pin `98670be3b`: PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2323](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2323>), merged as `1d10f9b3`. Deviation: one test-file change outside the notebook paths (`docs/plans/survey` added to `DENYLIST_DIRS` in `tests/unit/docs-architecture-anchor-resolver.test.js`), by ruling. The full pre-prune description is in the task snapshots and the comment trail (the two Survey comments of 08:03). The original copy plan from `24ac197f4` was superseded: it would have reverted LIN-4248's pointers; `98670be3b` keeps them.

**Done when (revised):**

* `git diff 98670be3b HEAD -- docs/plans/survey.md docs/plans/survey/` is empty after the merge.
* No other path changed.
* `lin-4248-survey-stages` and the full unit suite are green.

Known and left: `log.md` is a dated history, so an entry may name a file as it was then (for example `prompt-section-world.js`, since renamed `client-world.js`). Don't edit it; the paper reads the notebook as the operator's account.

comments.body:
## Survey open-0: LIN-4314 @ 165c61e7f

**Why this will be difficult: the ticket's own "Done when" breaks main's tests.**

The diff from `165c61e7f` to `24ac197f4` on these paths touches five files, all modified (no adds, no deletes): `log.md` +446, `notes-2026-11-05.md` +97, `place-ledger.md` +80, `prompt.md`, and `global-offshoot-prompt-v2-code.md`. The first three are the day's notebook work, and they copy over cleanly. The last two don't. That's because the edits went **both ways**, not just branch → main.

LIN-4248 (`29f14bf6`) didn't just copy the notebook. In `prompt.md` and `global-offshoot-prompt-v2-code.md` it replaced the hand-sent prompt text with a **"Live text moved (LIN-4248)"** pointer to `lib/prompt-template-defs.js`, so the text would live in one place. The branch never received that edit, so it still carries the full old text (with `{RECORD}` / `LIN-4150`, which the live templates no longer use). Copying `24ac197f4 -- <paths>` "unchanged" quietly reverts LIN-4248's single-source decision. Main has a test guarding exactly that: `tests/unit/lin-4248-survey-stages.test.js`, suite *"one live copy of the Survey text, in the templates"*.

I checked this in the scratch worktree (then restored it):
- at `165c61e7f`: 13/13 pass;
- after `git checkout 24ac197f4 -- docs/plans/survey.md docs/plans/survey/`: 2 fail, `prompt.md points at its template` and `survey-task: "You are looking at the ground before a task starts..." is copied into docs/plans/survey/prompt.md`.

So the two acceptance criteria and a green CI can't all hold. Someone has to decide, and the ticket's "Not this ticket: editing the notebook's content" rules out the obvious workaround.

**The real problem is upstream of this ticket.** The notebook has two homes that drift in opposite directions. The branch keeps the prose, while main keeps the "text lives in the template" edits. So every future "bring it up to date" copy will hit the same two files. This ticket fixes the symptom (main is a day stale). The cause is that LIN-4248's main-only edits were never put back on the branch.

**What I'd do first:**
1. Put LIN-4248's two pointer edits back on `claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j` first, and keep the branch's genuinely new hunk in `prompt.md`: the tidy-after q7 replacement, "since 5 Nov 14:50". Then re-pin the copy SHA to that commit. After that the literal copy and "Done when" both hold, and later syncs stay clean.
2. If the branch can't be touched, merge `prompt.md` by hunk instead: take the q7 hunk and keep main's pointer hunk. Keep main's `global-offshoot-prompt-v2-code.md` as it is, because the branch's only change there is the revert. Then change "Done when" to list these two files as the agreed exception.

**Smaller points:**
- The new `log.md` lines cite `tests/unit/helpers/prompt-section-world.js`, which doesn't exist on main. The paper "cites it at main", so that reference will dangle. It's only a note, but worth knowing before the paper links to it.
- The excluded-code risk (`2bebcc03` and the rest of the 199 branch commits, touching `lib/`, `routes/`, `public/`, `tests/`) is real but easy to avoid with a path-limited checkout. A `git diff --name-only origin/main` limited to `docs/plans/survey*` before the PR is enough to check it.
- `24ac197f4` is a snapshot of a branch that is still being worked on, so the copy will be stale again quickly. That's one more reason to fix the two-way drift than to sync by hand each time.

## Survey global: LIN-4314 @ 165c61e7f

(The repo is LinearViewer. `24ac197f4` is not an ancestor of main. The branch tip has since moved on to `f010ef7`, so the pinned commit is the right one to take from.)

**Where it lands.** `docs/plans/survey*` on main is a mirror of a notebook that lives on a research branch. LIN-4248 (`29f14bf6`) did more than copy it. It made a rule: the Survey prompt text lives in one place, the `survey-task` and `survey-place` templates in `lib/prompt-template-defs.js`. It replaced the prompt text in `prompt.md` and `global-offshoot-prompt-v2-code.md` with "Live text moved (LIN-4248)" pointers, and `tests/unit/lin-4248-survey-stages.test.js` enforces this. The test checks that both docs point at their template, and that no long line of either rendered Survey body appears in them. That made this area better: the duplicate is gone, and a test would catch it coming back.

**Done the obvious way.** The 5-file diff is mostly additive. `log.md` gains 446 lines, `notes-2026-11-05.md` 97 and `place-ledger.md` 80, all with no deletions. The ledger lines go after line 125, so the paper's `place-ledger.md@2f0c9d5b:15-51` citation is unaffected either way. Two files are not additive. At `24ac197f4`, both prompt docs still hold the older hand-sent prompt text, because the branch never took LIN-4248's edit. A copy "unchanged" would:
- remove both pointer paragraphs and bring back a second, already stale copy of each prompt (`LIN-4150`, `{RECORD}`, no `git fetch`), next to the live templates;
- fail both tests in the `LIN-4248 notebook` describe block;
- leave `lib/prompt-template-defs.js:95-96` pointing at docs that disagree with the code under it.

So the two Done-when lines conflict with CI and with LIN-4248's decision. An empty diff on these paths means a red `npm test`, unless the test changes, and that is outside "no other path changed". The ticket treats this as copying files. In fact it is a branch that diverged from a choice main has already made.

**Better, at a cost this task can carry.** Copy all five files from `24ac197f4`, but keep main's "Live text moved" paragraph in each prompt doc. Keep the one real addition, the tidy-after q7 block in `prompt.md`, since it is notebook content and not template text. Then the diff against `24ac197f4` is exactly those two pointer paragraphs. Change Done-when to say so and to require a green `lin-4248-survey-stages` test. Better still, and fixes the cause: first put the pointer edit onto the research branch, at a new pinned commit, so the copy really is unchanged. Without that, every future sync hits the same conflict.

**Not this task's.** Main holds a day-stale mirror of a notebook that keeps changing elsewhere, and nothing on main notices when it goes stale. The paper cites the branch (`@2f0c9d5b`), and the review evidence reads the branch directly. Either the notebook should move to main for good and be edited there, or main should cite the branch at a pinned commit and stop mirroring. Repeated "bring it up to date" tickets are the symptom.

## LIN-4314: PR open, CI red on a decision outside this ticket's paths

PR (draft): https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2323 (branch `feat/lin-4314-survey-notebook-sync`, commit `56c2d337`).

**Done:** `docs/plans/survey.md` and `docs/plans/survey/` are copied from `98670be3b` with a path-limited checkout. Only the four files that differ from main changed, all additive (+630). `git diff 98670be3b HEAD -- docs/plans/survey.md docs/plans/survey/` is empty. `lin-4248-survey-stages` passes 13/13. Secret scan passes. E2E shards 1-4 pass.

**Not green:** the Unit tests job fails 3 of 23,910 tests (CI and a local run agree). All three are new, in `tests/unit/docs-architecture-anchor-resolver.test.js`: `log.md:2212`, `log.md:2240` and `place-ledger.md:178` cite "CLAUDE.md line 58" for `observation-dom-shim.js`, but main's CLAUDE.md:58 is now the LIN-2023 paragraph. Main's copy of these files has no `CLAUDE.md:` citations, so the rows come only from this sync. The `CI success` gate is red as a result.

**Why I stopped rather than fixing it:** the ticket's "No other path changed" rule rules out the two real fixes, so this is a decision for you:

1. **Recommended:** add `docs/plans/survey` to `DENYLIST_DIRS` in `tests/unit/docs-architecture-anchor-resolver.test.js`. That test's own comment says the denylist is for "dated/frozen artifacts", and the notebook is dated history. This touches one test file outside the ticket's paths.
2. Edit the three citations in the notebook to name the section rather than the line. This breaks the "copy unchanged" criterion.
3. Land with the three rows red. Not recommended.

Once you pick one, I'll make the change, push, and confirm CI is green. The PR stays a draft until then. Merging is not mine to do.

Add docs/plans/survey to DENYLIST_DIRS in docs-architecture-anchor-resolver.test.js

— Ruling recorded via Harbour

## LIN-4314: CI green, PR ready for review

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2323 (no longer a draft). Head `378f20b7`.

**Fix applied:** `docs/plans/survey` added to `DENYLIST_DIRS` in `tests/unit/docs-architecture-anchor-resolver.test.js`, as option 1 recommended. This clears the three `CLAUDE.md:58` citation failures from the notebook sync.

**Verified:**
- `npm run test:unit`: 23,832 / 23,832 pass.
- `lin-4248-survey-stages`: 13/13 pass.
- `npm run secret-scan`: pass.
- CI on `378f20b7`: all green, including `CI success`, Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4 and Secret scan.

Paths changed: the four `docs/plans/survey/` files (additive, +630) and the one denylist line. Merge is for the orchestrator or a human after review.

## Review — LIN-4314

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2323, reviewed at head `378f20b7` (base `165c61e7f`; main is now `f73f1b11`).

CI: green on `378f20b7`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, and `CI success`.

**Scope versus the revised plan.** Five paths changed: `docs/plans/survey/{log,notes-2026-11-05,place-ledger,prompt}.md` (only additions, +630) and one line plus a comment in `tests/unit/docs-architecture-anchor-resolver.test.js`. The test file is outside the notebook paths. The ruling on 08:23 approved it, so it does not overrun the plan. `survey.md` and the other survey files already matched the pin, so they don't show in the diff.
- `98670be3b` is an ancestor of `origin/claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j`, so the pin is real. `git diff 98670be3b 378f20b7 -- docs/plans/survey.md docs/plans/survey/` is **empty**.
- No branch code came along: no `lib/`, `routes/`, `public/` or `2bebcc03` content.
- `prompt.md` keeps main's "Live text moved (LIN-4248)" pointer and adds only the tidy-after q7 block. `global-offshoot-prompt-v2-code.md` did not change.

**Regression check.** Since the base, main has one new commit (`f73f1b11`, LIN-4307), and it touches none of these paths. I merged current main into the PR locally. In the merged tree, `anchor-resolver` and `lin-4248-survey-stages` pass 134/134, and the diff against the pin is still empty. The PR keeps LIN-4248's single-source decision (`29f14bf6`) and does not undo it. The edit to the LIN-2896 denylist is additive and follows its stated rule ("dated/frozen artifacts").

**Mutation checks** (I reverted each one afterwards):
- I removed `'docs/plans/survey'` from `DENYLIST_DIRS`. The resolver goes red on exactly the 3 rows reported (`log.md:2212`, `log.md:2240`, `place-ledger.md:178` → CLAUDE.md line 58). So the denylist entry is what keeps it green.
- I set `prompt.md` and `global-offshoot-prompt-v2-code.md` back to `24ac197f4`. `lin-4248-survey-stages` goes to 11/13: the pointer test and the no-duplicated-body test fail. So that test does guard the LIN-4248 decision this sync had to keep.

**One of a class?** I checked for siblings. The two-way drift between the branch and main is the class. In this snapshot both prompt docs are resolved, and the other three files only gain lines. Nothing else inside the ticket is left unhandled.

One side effect: the denylist applies to the whole `docs/plans/survey/` directory, including `prompt.md` and `round-2/`, `round-3/`. Before this change, main's copy had no checkable citations there, so no coverage is lost today. `lin-4248-survey-stages` still guards the prompt docs. This was ruled on and nothing is left to do.

Known and left as the ticket says: `log.md` names `prompt-section-world.js`, which has since been renamed. It is dated history, so it is not edited.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (Done-when, revised: "the diff is empty *after the merge*"). CI ran on the PR head, not on main after the merge. **Settle after the merge:** on `origin/main`, `git diff 98670be3b origin/main -- docs/plans/survey.md docs/plans/survey/` must be empty, and `git diff --name-only <pre-merge main> origin/main` must list only those 5 paths. A squash merge with conflict edits would show up as a non-empty diff. I simulated the merge with `f73f1b11` locally and it was clean, but that doesn't cover commits that land on main after it.
- **Outside**: the cause of the drift. The notebook is mirrored by hand from a research branch that is still active, so every "bring it up to date" sync will hit the same two-way drift. Both Surveys raised this. Close-out should file one follow-up (move the notebook to main for good, or have main cite the branch at a pinned commit and stop mirroring), after checking no such ticket exists. This deliverable does not depend on it.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. The sync matches `98670be3b` exactly on the ticket's paths, LIN-4248 is intact, the one change outside those paths was ruled on, and both load-bearing tests fail when the code they guard is mutated. All that is left is the check after the merge, plus filing the one outside follow-up.

## Close-out — LIN-4314

**Merged:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2323, squash-merged as `1d10f9b3f029d0326121103142da5cc41fd7e34e`, pinned with `--match-head-commit 378f20b7` (the commit CI passed on). Review verdict on record: Approve, with a ledger.

**Changes I made after the approval:** none. No fixes were asked for beyond the ledger; the review's only code-side change (the `DENYLIST_DIRS` entry) was already in the PR under the 08:23 ruling.

**CI:** CI exists and applies. On `378f20b7`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4, Secret scan and `CI success` all green; merge state was CLEAN. Main moved to `f73f1b11` (LIN-4307, touches none of these paths) after the CI run; review had simulated that merge locally. The Tests run on main at `1d10f9b3` was still in progress when I closed; I did not wait for it.

**Ledger**
- *Inside — diff empty after the merge:* on `origin/main` at `1d10f9b3`, `git diff 98670be3b origin/main -- docs/plans/survey.md docs/plans/survey/` is empty (0 lines). `git diff --name-only f73f1b11 origin/main` lists exactly 5 paths: `docs/plans/survey/{log,notes-2026-11-05,place-ledger,prompt}.md` and `tests/unit/docs-architecture-anchor-resolver.test.js` (the ruled change). Nothing else changed.
- *Inside — tests on merged main:* ran `docs-architecture-anchor-resolver` and `lin-4248-survey-stages` on `1d10f9b3`: 134/134 pass.
- *Outside — notebook mirror drift:* filed as LIN-4316 (Medium, `kind:follow-up`, `front:operating-model`), related to this ticket. I searched first; no existing ticket covers it.
- No named monitor or rollback was recorded by review for this item; none was needed (docs and one test denylist line, no runtime deploy).

**Deploy:** the merged change is docs plus a unit-test file; nothing deploys from it, so there were no post-deploy steps.

**Left / not run:** the full-suite CI run on main `1d10f9b3` was still running at close; anyone can check `gh run list --branch main`.

**Description:** archived (snapshot verified) and pruned to a stub; see the description.

issue.title: Survey notebook is hand-mirrored from a research branch: decide one home (main for good, or cite the branch at a pinned commit)
